requirements.title: This game needs a computer with WebGPU
requirements.body.no-webgpu: Boon Sop: The Unbroken Debt runs in browsers with WebGPU. Please update your browser, or try one listed below.
requirements.body.software-renderer: Your browser is drawing without the graphics card (software rendering). Turn on hardware acceleration in the browser settings, update your graphics driver, then reload.
requirements.body.mobile: Boon Sop: The Unbroken Debt is made for laptops and desktop computers with a keyboard and mouse or trackpad. Phones and tablets aren't supported yet.
requirements.minimum.value: Laptop or desktop with integrated graphics (Intel Iris Xe, AMD Radeon 680M, Apple M1, Snapdragon X) · 8 GB RAM · Low quality
requirements.recommended.value: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700 / Apple M1 Pro or better · 16 GB RAM · Medium quality at 1080p
requirements.browser.value: Current Chrome or Edge · Safari on macOS 26+ · Firefox on Windows or Apple Silicon
render.stall.title: The picture has stopped updating
render.stall.body: The game is still trying to draw it. If this message doesn't go away, reload the page.

satchel.title: Satchel
